explainer.intro: Deposit a single asset. Juicer manages borrowing and converts strategy yield back into your deposited asset.
explainer.deposit.label: Deposit
explainer.earn.label: Earn
explainer.withdraw.label: Withdraw
explainer.deposit.description: Your deposit supplies collateral and creates position shares. Juicer then builds the leveraged strategy gradually.
explainer.deposit.note: Your deposit makes no strategy trade; paying with another asset only swaps it into the collateral first. Keepers deploy pooled collateral as market conditions allow.
explainer.earn.description: Harvested yield is converted into your deposited asset after costs and fees. Funded earnings stay invested and are included in your balance.
explainer.earn.note: There is nothing to claim. Yield that is not harvested yet shows separately as pending yield.
explainer.withdraw.description: Request a full or partial withdrawal. Your shares stay invested during the cooldown, then settle into your deposited asset.
explainer.withdraw.note: The cooldown is the earliest unwind start, not a payout deadline.
explainer.risk: Returns are variable. The leveraged strategy can lose value or be liquidated, and withdrawals may be delayed. Principal and immediate repayment are not guaranteed.

deposit.alert.paused: This vault is temporarily not accepting new deposits.
deposit.alert.full: The vault has reached its TVL cap. New deposits are not accepted until capacity becomes available.
deposit.alert.notReady: This vault is not open for deposits yet.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {{symbol}}
withdraw.carryEstimate: The strategy currently has a funding deficit. Your collateral claim is not reduced, but settlement may take longer while funding is recovered.
withdraw.ack: Withdrawals unlock after a {{duration}} cooldown, then settle in parts as the vault frees liquidity. Unconverted yield may pay out separately in HOLLAR, after costs.
withdraw.blocked.paused: The vault is paused. Withdrawal requests are temporarily unavailable.
strategy.apyEstimate: Indicative annual carry assuming all collateral is deployed at current rates and source leverage, after source and Main borrowing costs and harvest fees.
Returns differ while collateral awaits deployment. Swap fees, slippage and conversion delays are excluded.
This is not realized crypto APY; unconverted yield is not funded crypto.
positions.pendingYield.tooltip: Estimated unconverted yield, shown in {{symbol}}. It can change and is not yet part of your balance. After harvest, costs, fees and debt servicing, the remainder is added automatically. Nothing needs to be claimed.
positions.harvest.reserve.label: Waiting for reserves
positions.harvest.reserve.description: The shared strategy needs {{gap, number(maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} HOLLAR to cover principal, withdrawals and execution reserves, then at least {{minimum, number(maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} HOLLAR of surplus. These are strategy-wide requirements, not deductions from your balance.
positions.harvest.minimum.label: Below harvest minimum
positions.harvest.minimum.description: The surplus above principal, withdrawals and execution reserves is below the strategy-wide harvest minimum of {{minimum, number(maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} HOLLAR.
positions.harvest.capacity.label: Waiting for harvest capacity
positions.harvest.capacity.description: The strategy has no harvest capacity under its current safety limits. Your pending amount is not yet available to compound.
positions.harvest.awaiting.label: Awaiting harvest
positions.harvest.awaiting.description: The source has harvest capacity. Execution limits and keeper checks still determine when it can be converted and added to your balance.
positions.harvest.paused.label: Harvest paused
positions.harvest.paused.description: The vault or its source is paused. Harvesting must wait until it resumes.
positions.harvest.accounting.label: Awaiting settlement
positions.harvest.accounting.description: Source proceeds or costs must be allocated before harvesting can continue.
positions.harvest.service.label: Awaiting debt servicing
positions.harvest.service.description: Main debt servicing is currently blocking harvest for this vault.
positions.harvest.unavailable.label: Harvest status unavailable
positions.harvest.unavailable.descriptio: The current harvest conditions could not be read. The pending estimate does not confirm that a harvest can execute.
deposit.executionDescription: Once confirmed, your deposit supplies collateral and mints funded vault shares.
Keepers then deploy the position gradually; your deposit makes no strategy trade.
Paying with another asset first swaps it into the collateral within your trade limit.
If approval is needed, it comes before the deposit, as its own step or in the same transaction.
deposit.approve.timeout: The approval hasn't been confirmed on-chain yet. Please try again.
deposit.toast.success: {{ amount }} deposited; strategy deployment follows gradually
deposit.failed: The deposit could not complete. Check your balance and the current vault status, then retry. A completed token approval remains available for your next attempt.
deposit.swap.title: Swap and deposit
deposit.swap.description: Swaps {{ amountIn }} for at least {{ amount }} and deposits {{ amount }} in one transaction. Any {{ symbol }} received above that stays in your wallet.
deposit.swap.deposit.tooltip: The swap's guaranteed minimum at your trade limit. Any {{ symbol }} received above it stays in your wallet.
deposit.swap.unavailable: No {{ symbolIn }} to {{ symbol }} quote is available right now. Try another amount, or deposit {{ symbol }} directly.
deposit.swap.failed: The swap and deposit could not complete. Check your balances and the current vault status, then retry. If a swap already completed, its {{ symbol }} stays in your wallet and can be deposited directly.
deposit.swapStep.timeout: The swap hasn't been confirmed on-chain yet. Please try again.
positions.readFailed: Some position or withdrawal data could not be refreshed. Amounts may be out of date. Try again after the connection recovers.
strategy.deploymentDescription: Collateral awaiting deployment is pooled within each vault and includes deposits and harvested earnings.
Keepers borrow and trade gradually when prices meet the vault’s limits. This is not a personal queue or a completion estimate.
Withdrawals follow the usual withdrawal queue.
transfer.title: Send {{shareSymbol}}
transfer.description: This sends position shares, not the underlying asset.
transfer.juicerDescription: The recipient receives your Juicer position, not {{symbol}}. Amounts are shown as the current {{symbol}} equivalent.
transfer.previewOnly: Preview only — transfers are not connected yet.
